香港讀者看：一月花十萬元買的金飾，今天賣回只剩約54,000元。金價跌三成，人卻虧了快一半。來源：內地財經解說頻道《算給你看》。
上海金基準價由1月29日的每克1,248元跌至11月5日的886元（−29%）。買進按金店零售價（中國黃金1月24日足金飾品每克1,562元，基礎金價1,124元），賣出按金店回收價（周大福11月8日每克843元）：中間那一截，從一開始就不是黃金。今日金價：每盎司3,883.40美元（Kitco，11月14日）。

Hong Kong: gold jewellery bought for 100,000 yuan in January sells back today for about 54,000. Gold is down about 30% from its peak; the buyer loses nearly half. The Shanghai benchmark fell from 1,248 yuan a gram on 29 January to 886 on 5 November (−29%). You buy at the shop's retail price (China Gold, 24 January: 1,562 yuan a gram for fine-gold jewellery against a base price of 1,124) and sell at its buy-back price (Chow Tai Fook, 8 November: 843 yuan a gram). The gap was never gold. Spot gold today: $3,883.40 an ounce (Kitco, 14 November).

Video: 算給你看, YouTube, 10 Nov 2026. Sources: the creator's cited pages (Shanghai Gold Exchange benchmark; China Gold web archive, 24 Jan 2026; Chow Tai Fook online buy-back price, 8 Nov 2026); Kitco.
